title: Not comfortable
text: Not comfortable. This is NOT an all-day lounge chair. I had back spasms all up and down my spine after 4 hours of laying in the chair. Couldn’t find a good position. Put a full size pillow under me and behind me in order to keep sitting in it without pain. But I’m sure it’s fine for an hour or two.
